rows.title: Using Sequential Runtime Distributions for the Parallel Speedup Prediction of SAT Local Search

rows.difference: reports exponential parallel speedup for a projection method; it is the kind of isolated speedup claim our serial baseline re-prices.

rows.difference: explains when speedups exceed the processor count; we show a series of speedups all bought by the same parallelism.
rows.title: A note on superlinear speedup

rows.difference: models parallel speedup from program structure; our structure is a think phase and a call phase sharing a pool.
rows.anchor: A Model for Speedup of Parallel Programs

rows.anchor: Scheduling parallel jobs with linear speedup

rows.difference: defines fixed-size speedup as a metric; our ratio is taken at fixed work, which is that definition.
rows.title: Fixed-Size Speedup
rows.venue: Encyclopedia of Parallel Computing

rows.difference: explains superlinear speedup by search-space effects; our speedups come from overlapping waits, which is a different source.
rows.title: Unconventional Wisdom: Superlinear Speedup and Inherently Parallel Computations
rows.venue: From Parallel to Emergent Computing

rows.difference: re-examines how parallel speedup should be measured; we adopt a paired per-seed ratio over the serial schedule.
rows.title: Another view on parallel speedup

rows.difference: builds a performance-evaluation framework for virtual-core speedup; we use a deterministic simulator with ground truth by construction.
rows.anchor: DLT-Aware Performance Evaluation Framework for Virtual-Core Speedup
rows.title: A DLT-Aware Performance Evaluation Framework for Virtual-Core Speedup Modeling
rows.venue: Future Internet

rows.difference: distributes workload for sustainable server utilisation; our utilisation is derived from busy time and makespan, not assumed.

rows.difference: parallelises a tiled decomposition from fork-join to asynchronous tasks; our structure is one agent with an early-issued call.

rows.anchor: Improved Online Scheduling of Moldable Task Graphs
rows.title: Improved Online Scheduling of Moldable Task Graphs under Common Speedup Models

rows.title: Blockwise Stochastic Variance-Reduced Methods with Parallel Speedup for Multi-Block Bilevel Optimization
